description: Ablation comparison assembled from measured runs only. A vs B isolates what constrained generation adds; B vs C isolates what targeted RAG adds; C vs D isolates what the evidence-aware controller adds (difficulty + ranking).

metric_definitions.target_match_rate: share of cases where the pipeline's decision targets the benchmark's expected concept/relationship/misconception
metric_definitions.grounded_rate: share of generated probes whose every cited grounding id was actually supplied (teacher-grounding correctness)
metric_definitions.target_terms_rate: share of generated probes whose wording mentions the target
metric_definitions.mean_novel_term_share: mean share of a question's content words absent from the supplied teacher material — a strict hallucination PROXY, comparable across conditions, not a hallucination rate
metric_definitions.fallback_rate: share of probes realized by the fallback provider
metric_definitions.plan_agreement_rate: condition D only: share of cases where the controller's top-utility candidate is the same target the v1 plan slot addresses. Disagreements on this benchmark come from alphabetical tie-breaking among equal-utility (0.55) pending concepts, not from evidence-driven divergence — see README §20
metric_definitions.diagnostic_usefulness: NOT MEASURED: requires manual labeling that has not been done

B.label: LLM without targeted RAG (whole topic as context)

C.label: targeted RAG + LLM (rule-chosen target, fixed difficulty)

D.label: evidence-aware controller + targeted RAG + constrained LLM
